summary.text: Patrick Sheehan is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 37, appointed to the seat in April 2024, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes working as a law enforcement officer with the Plainfield Police Department.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Sheehan was born in Chicago, Illinois, and graduated from Christ the King Catholic School.

His career experience includes working as a law enforcement officer with the Plainfield Police Department, and he has been affiliated with the Lockport Jr Porters Football program, the Cheer program, and the Lockport Soccer Club.
The Republican Party of Illinois appointed Sheehan to the House seat on April 12, 2024, to replace Tim Ozinga.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Ethics & Elections, Gaming, Housing, Judiciary - Criminal, and Police & Fire committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
